ayahs.arabicText: طٰسٓمّٓ
ayahs.translation: Ta'. Sin. Mim

ayahs.arabicText: تِلْكَ اٰیٰتُ الْكِتٰبِ الْمُبِیْنِ
ayahs.translation: These are the verses of the Clear Book.

ayahs.arabicText: نَتْلُوْا عَلَیْكَ مِنْ نَّبَاِ مُوْسٰى وَ فِرْعَوْنَ بِالْحَقِّ لِقَوْمٍ یُّؤْمِنُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: We recount to you with truth some parts of the story of Moses and Pharaoh for the benefit of those who believe.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ عَلَا فِی الْاَرْضِ وَ جَعَلَ اَهْلَهَا شِیَعًا یَّسْتَضْعِفُ طَآئِفَةً مِّنْهُمْ یُذَبِّحُ اَبْنَآءَهُمْ وَ یَسْتَحْیٖ نِسَآءَهُمْ١ؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ مِنَ الْمُفْسِدِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Indeed Pharaoh transgressed in the land and divided its people into sections. One group of them he humiliated, and slew their sons and spared their daughters. Truly he was among the mischief-makers.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ نُرِیْدُ اَنْ نَّمُنَّ عَلَى الَّذِیْنَ اسْتُضْعِفُوْا فِی الْاَرْضِ وَ نَجْعَلَهُمْ اَئِمَّةً وَّ نَجْعَلَهُمُ الْوٰرِثِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: We wanted to bestow favour on those who were oppressed in the land. We wanted to make them leaders and heirs

ayahs.arabicText: وَ نُمَكِّنَ لَهُمْ فِی الْاَرْضِ وَ نُرِیَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَ هَامٰنَ وَ جُنُوْدَهُمَا مِنْهُمْ مَّا كَانُوْا یَحْذَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: and to grant them power in the land, and make Pharaoh and Haman and their hosts see what they had feared.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَوْحَیْنَاۤ اِلٰۤى اُمِّ مُوْسٰۤى اَنْ اَرْضِعِیْهِ١ۚ فَاِذَا خِفْتِ عَلَیْهِ فَاَلْقِیْهِ فِی الْیَمِّ وَ لَا تَخَافِیْ وَ لَا تَحْزَنِیْ١ۚ اِنَّا رَآدُّوْهُ اِلَیْكِ وَ جَاعِلُوْهُ مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: We suggested to the mother of Moses: "Suckle your child, but when you fear for his life cast him into the river and be not fearful nor grieve, for We shall restore him to you and make him one of the Messengers."

ayahs.arabicText: فَالْتَقَطَهٗۤ اٰلُ فِرْعَوْنَ لِیَكُوْنَ لَهُمْ عَدُوًّا وَّ حَزَنًا١ؕ اِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ وَ هَامٰنَ وَ جُنُوْدَهُمَا كَانُوْا خٰطِئِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Then Pharaoh's household picked him up (from the river) that he may be their adversary and be a cause of sorrow to them. Surely Pharaoh and Haman and their hosts erred (in their scheming).

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالَتِ امْرَاَتُ فِرْعَوْنَ قُرَّتُ عَیْنٍ لِّیْ وَ لَكَ١ؕ لَا تَقْتُلُوْهُ١ۖۗ عَسٰۤى اَنْ یَّنْفَعَنَاۤ اَوْ نَتَّخِذَهٗ وَلَدًا وَّ هُمْ لَا یَشْعُرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: The wife of Pharaoh said: "Here is a delight of the eye to me and to you. Do not kill him. Maybe he will prove useful for us, or we may adopt him as a son." They were unaware of the end of it all.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَصْبَحَ فُؤَادُ اُمِّ مُوْسٰى فٰرِغًا١ؕ اِنْ كَادَتْ لَتُبْدِیْ بِهٖ لَوْ لَاۤ اَنْ رَّبَطْنَا عَلٰى قَلْبِهَا لِتَكُوْنَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: On the other hand, the heart of Moses' mother was sorely distressed. Had We not strengthened her heart that she might have full faith (in Our promise), she would have disclosed the secret.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالَتْ لِاُخْتِهٖ قُصِّیْهِ١٘ فَبَصُرَتْ بِهٖ عَنْ جُنُبٍ وَّ هُمْ لَا یَشْعُرُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: She told the sister of Moses: "Follow him." So she kept watch over him unperceived (by the enemies).

ayahs.arabicText: وَ حَرَّمْنَا عَلَیْهِ الْمَرَاضِعَ مِنْ قَبْلُ فَقَالَتْ هَلْ اَدُلُّكُمْ عَلٰۤى اَهْلِ بَیْتٍ یَّكْفُلُوْنَهٗ لَكُمْ وَ هُمْ لَهٗ نٰصِحُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We had already forbidden the breasts of the nurses for the child. (So seeing the girl) said: "Shall I direct you to the people of a household that will rear him with utter sincerity?"

ayahs.arabicText: فَرَدَدْنٰهُ اِلٰۤى اُمِّهٖ كَیْ تَقَرَّ عَیْنُهَا وَ لَا تَحْزَنَ وَ لِتَعْلَمَ اَنَّ وَعْدَ اللّٰهِ حَقٌّ وَّ لٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا یَعْلَمُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Thus did We restore Moses to his mother that her eyes might be comforted and she might not grieve, and realise that the promise of Allah was true. But most people are unaware of this.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَمَّا بَلَغَ اَشُدَّهٗ وَ اسْتَوٰۤى اٰتَیْنٰهُ حُكْمًا وَّ عِلْمًا١ؕ وَ كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِی الْمُحْسِنِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: When Moses reached the age of full youth and grew to maturity, We bestowed upon him wisdom and knowledge. Thus do We reward those who do good.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ دَخَلَ الْمَدِیْنَةَ عَلٰى حِیْنِ غَفْلَةٍ مِّنْ اَهْلِهَا فَوَجَدَ فِیْهَا رَجُلَیْنِ یَقْتَتِلٰنِ١٘ۗ هٰذَا مِنْ شِیْعَتِهٖ وَ هٰذَا مِنْ عَدُوِّهٖ١ۚ فَاسْتَغَاثَهُ الَّذِیْ مِنْ شِیْعَتِهٖ عَلَى الَّذِیْ مِنْ عَدُوِّهٖ١ۙ فَوَكَزَهٗ مُوْسٰى فَقَضٰى عَلَیْهِ١٘ۗ قَالَ هٰذَا مِنْ عَمَلِ الشَّیْطٰنِ١ؕ اِنَّهٗ عَدُوٌّ مُّضِلٌّ مُّبِیْنٌ
ayahs.translation: Once he entered the city at a time when its people were heedless, and he encountered two men fighting, one of whom belonged to his own people and the other to his foes. Now the man belonging to Moses' own people cried out to him for help against the man from the foes, and Moses struck him with his fist and finished him. Moses said: "This is an act of Satan. Surely he is an enemy who openly misleads."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّیْ ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِیْ فَاغْفِرْ لِیْ فَغَفَرَ لَهٗ١ؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الْغَفُوْرُ الرَّحِیْمُ
ayahs.translation: Then he prayed: "My Lord! I have indeed inflicted wrong on myself, so do forgive me," wherefore Allah forgave him for He is Ever Forgiving, Most Merciful.

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَاۤ اَنْعَمْتَ عَلَیَّ فَلَنْ اَكُوْنَ ظَهِیْرًا لِّلْمُجْرِمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Thereupon Moses vowed: "My Lord, because of the favour that You have done me I shall never support the guilty."

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَصْبَحَ فِی الْمَدِیْنَةِ خَآئِفًا یَّتَرَقَّبُ فَاِذَا الَّذِی اسْتَنْصَرَهٗ بِالْاَمْسِ یَسْتَصْرِخُهٗ١ؕ قَالَ لَهٗ مُوْسٰۤى اِنَّكَ لَغَوِیٌّ مُّبِیْنٌ
ayahs.translation: The next morning he proceeded to the city in fear and looking around as one apprehensive of danger when all of a sudden, the man who had sought his help the day before again called out to him for his help. Moses said to him: "Clearly, you are a very misguided fellow."

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَمَّاۤ اَنْ اَرَادَ اَنْ یَّبْطِشَ بِالَّذِیْ هُوَ عَدُوٌّ لَّهُمَا١ۙ قَالَ یٰمُوْسٰۤى اَتُرِیْدُ اَنْ تَقْتُلَنِیْ كَمَا قَتَلْتَ نَفْسًۢا بِالْاَمْسِ١ۖۗ اِنْ تُرِیْدُ اِلَّاۤ اَنْ تَكُوْنَ جَبَّارًا فِی الْاَرْضِ وَ مَا تُرِیْدُ اَنْ تَكُوْنَ مِنَ الْمُصْلِحِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: And when Moses decided to lay his violent hands on the man belonging to the enemy, he cried out: "Moses, do you intend to kill me as you killed a person yesterday?" You simply want to live in the land as a tyrant, and do not wish to set things right."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ جَآءَ رَجُلٌ مِّنْ اَقْصَا الْمَدِیْنَةِ یَسْعٰى١٘ قَالَ یٰمُوْسٰۤى اِنَّ الْمَلَاَ یَاْتَمِرُوْنَ بِكَ لِیَقْتُلُوْكَ فَاخْرُجْ اِنِّیْ لَكَ مِنَ النّٰصِحِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Then a man came running from the farther end of the city and said: "O Moses, the nobles are deliberating about you that they may put you to death. So do be gone. I am one of your well-wishers."

ayahs.arabicText: فَخَرَجَ مِنْهَا خَآئِفًا یَّتَرَقَّبُ١٘ قَالَ رَبِّ نَجِّنِیْ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظّٰلِمِیْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Soon after hearing this Moses departed in a state of fear, looking around as one in apprehension and prayed: "My Lord, deliver me from these unjust people."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَمَّا تَوَجَّهَ تِلْقَآءَ مَدْیَنَ قَالَ عَسٰى رَبِّیْۤ اَنْ یَّهْدِیَنِیْ سَوَآءَ السَّبِیْلِ
ayahs.translation: When (after his departure from Egypt) Moses headed towards Midian, he said: "I hope my Lord will show me the right Path."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَمَّا وَرَدَ مَآءَ مَدْیَنَ وَجَدَ عَلَیْهِ اُمَّةً مِّنَ النَّاسِ یَسْقُوْنَ١٘۬ وَ وَجَدَ مِنْ دُوْنِهِمُ امْرَاَتَیْنِ تَذُوْدٰنِ١ۚ قَالَ مَا خَطْبُكُمَا١ؕ قَالَتَا لَا نَسْقِیْ حَتّٰى یُصْدِرَ الرِّعَآءُ١ٚ وَ اَبُوْنَا شَیْخٌ كَبِیْرٌ
ayahs.translation: When he arrived at the spring of Midian, he found there a crowd of people watering their flocks, and he found apart from them two women holding their flocks back. He asked the women: "What is it that troubles you?" They said: "We cannot water our flocks until the shepherds take their flocks away, and our father is a very old man."

ayahs.arabicText: فَسَقٰى لَهُمَا ثُمَّ تَوَلّٰۤى اِلَى الظِّلِّ فَقَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّیْ لِمَاۤ اَنْزَلْتَ اِلَیَّ مِنْ خَیْرٍ فَقِیْرٌ
ayahs.translation: On hearing this Moses watered their flocks for them, and then returned in a shaded place and said: "My Lord, I am truly in great need of any good that You might send down to me."

ayahs.arabicText: فَجَآءَتْهُ اِحْدٰىهُمَا تَمْشِیْ عَلَى اسْتِحْیَآءٍ١٘ قَالَتْ اِنَّ اَبِیْ یَدْعُوْكَ لِیَجْزِیَكَ اَجْرَ مَا سَقَیْتَ لَنَا١ؕ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهٗ وَ قَصَّ عَلَیْهِ الْقَصَصَ١ۙ قَالَ لَا تَخَفْ١۫ٙ نَجَوْتَ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظّٰلِمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Soon thereafter one of the two women came to him, walking bashfully, and said: "My father invites you that he may reward you for your having watered our flocks for us. " When Moses came to him and narrated to him the whole of his story, he said: "Have no fear. You are now safe from the iniquitous people."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَتْ اِحْدٰىهُمَا یٰۤاَبَتِ اسْتَاْجِرْهُ١٘ اِنَّ خَیْرَ مَنِ اسْتَاْجَرْتَ الْقَوِیُّ الْاَمِیْنُ
ayahs.translation: One of the two women said: "Father, employ this man in your service. The best whom you might employ is he who is strong and trustworthy."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ اِنِّیْۤ اُرِیْدُ اَنْ اُنْكِحَكَ اِحْدَى ابْنَتَیَّ هٰتَیْنِ عَلٰۤى اَنْ تَاْجُرَنِیْ ثَمٰنِیَ حِجَجٍ١ۚ فَاِنْ اَتْمَمْتَ عَشْرًا فَمِنْ عِنْدِكَ١ۚ وَ مَاۤ اُرِیْدُ اَنْ اَشُقَّ عَلَیْكَ١ؕ سَتَجِدُنِیْۤ اِنْ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ مِنَ الصّٰلِحِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Her father said to Moses: "I want to marry one of these two daughters of mine to you if you serve me for eight years. But if you complete ten years, that will be of your own accord (but not an obligation). I do not intend to treat you harshly. If Allah wills, you will find me an upright man."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ ذٰلِكَ بَیْنِیْ وَ بَیْنَكَ١ؕ اَیَّمَا الْاَجَلَیْنِ قَضَیْتُ فَلَا عُدْوَانَ عَلَیَّ١ؕ وَ اللّٰهُ عَلٰى مَا نَقُوْلُ وَكِیْلٌ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Moses replied: "So that is agreed between me and you. Whichever of the two terms I fulfil, I trust that I shall not be wronged. Allah is a witness over the covenant we are committing ourselves to."

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَمَّا قَضٰى مُوْسَى الْاَجَلَ وَ سَارَ بِاَهْلِهٖۤ اٰنَسَ مِنْ جَانِبِ الطُّوْرِ نَارًا١ۚ قَالَ لِاَهْلِهِ امْكُثُوْۤا اِنِّیْۤ اٰنَسْتُ نَارًا لَّعَلِّیْۤ اٰتِیْكُمْ مِّنْهَا بِخَبَرٍ اَوْ جَذْوَةٍ مِّنَ النَّارِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَصْطَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: When Moses had fulfilled the term and was journeying with his family, he perceived a fire in the direction of the Mount (Sinai). He said to his family: "Wait here; I have observed a fire. Maybe I will bring to you some news or a brand of fire from there that you may warm yourselves."

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَمَّاۤ اَتٰىهَا نُوْدِیَ مِنْ شَاطِئِ الْوَادِ الْاَیْمَنِ فِی الْبُقْعَةِ الْمُبٰرَكَةِ مِنَ الشَّجَرَةِ اَنْ یّٰمُوْسٰۤى اِنِّیْۤ اَنَا اللّٰهُ رَبُّ الْعٰلَمِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: But when he came to the fire, a cry was heard from the right bank of the valley, from a tree in the hallowed ground: "O Moses, verily I am Allah, the Lord of all creatures of the Universe."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَنْ اَلْقِ عَصَاكَ١ؕ فَلَمَّا رَاٰهَا تَهْتَزُّ كَاَنَّهَا جَآنٌّ وَّلّٰى مُدْبِرًا وَّ لَمْ یُعَقِّبْ١ؕ یٰمُوْسٰۤى اَقْبِلْ وَ لَا تَخَفْ١۫ اِنَّكَ مِنَ الْاٰمِنِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: He received the command: "Throw away your rod!" But when he saw the rod writhing as though it were a serpent, he turned back in retreat, and did not even look behind. (He was told): "O Moses, go ahead and have no fear. You are perfectly secure.

ayahs.arabicText: اُسْلُكْ یَدَكَ فِیْ جَیْبِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَیْضَآءَ مِنْ غَیْرِ سُوْٓءٍ١٘ وَّ اضْمُمْ اِلَیْكَ جَنَاحَكَ مِنَ الرَّهْبِ فَذٰنِكَ بُرْهَانٰنِ مِنْ رَّبِّكَ اِلٰى فِرْعَوْنَ وَ مَلَاۡئِهٖ١ؕ اِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْا قَوْمًا فٰسِقِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Put your hand into your bosom, and it will come out shining without any blemish; and draw your hand close to your body to still your fear. Those are the two clear Signs from your Lord for Pharaoh and his chiefs, for truly they are a disobedient people."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّیْ قَتَلْتُ مِنْهُمْ نَفْسًا فَاَخَافُ اَنْ یَّقْتُلُوْنِ
ayahs.translation: Moses said: "My Lord, I have killed one person from among them, and I fear that they will kill me.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَخِیْ هٰرُوْنُ هُوَ اَفْصَحُ مِنِّیْ لِسَانًا فَاَرْسِلْهُ مَعِیَ رِدْاً یُّصَدِّقُنِیْۤ١٘ اِنِّیْۤ اَخَافُ اَنْ یُّكَذِّبُوْنِ
ayahs.translation: My brother Aaron is more eloquent in speech than I: so send him with me as a helper to confirm my truthfulness for I fear that they will reject me as a liar."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ سَنَشُدُّ عَضُدَكَ بِاَخِیْكَ وَ نَجْعَلُ لَكُمَا سُلْطٰنًا فَلَا یَصِلُوْنَ اِلَیْكُمَا١ۛۚ بِاٰیٰتِنَاۤ١ۛۚ اَنْتُمَا وَ مَنِ اتَّبَعَكُمَا الْغٰلِبُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: He said: "We will certainly strengthen you through your brother and will invest both of you with such power that they shall not be able to hurt you. With the help of Our Signs the two of you and your followers will prevail."

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ مُّوْسٰى بِاٰیٰتِنَا بَیِّنٰتٍ قَالُوْا مَا هٰذَاۤ اِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّفْتَرًى وَّ مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهٰذَا فِیْۤ اٰبَآئِنَا الْاَوَّلِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: But when Moses came to them with Our Clear Signs, they said: "This is nothing but a magic that has been contrived. We never heard anything like it from our ancestors of yore."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالَ مُوْسٰى رَبِّیْۤ اَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ جَآءَ بِالْهُدٰى مِنْ عِنْدِهٖ وَ مَنْ تَكُوْنُ لَهٗ عَاقِبَةُ الدَّارِ١ؕ اِنَّهٗ لَا یُفْلِحُ الظّٰلِمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Moses replied: "My Lord knows best who comes with guidance from Him, and also whose end will be the best in the Hereafter. As for the wrongdoers, they shall not prosper."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ یٰۤاَیُّهَا الْمَلَاُ مَا عَلِمْتُ لَكُمْ مِّنْ اِلٰهٍ غَیْرِیْ١ۚ فَاَوْقِدْ لِیْ یٰهَامٰنُ عَلَى الطِّیْنِ فَاجْعَلْ لِّیْ صَرْحًا لَّعَلِّیْۤ اَطَّلِعُ اِلٰۤى اِلٰهِ مُوْسٰى١ۙ وَ اِنِّیْ لَاَظُنُّهٗ مِنَ الْكٰذِبِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Pharaoh said: "O nobles, I do not know that you have any god beside myself. Haman, bake bricks out of clay and build a lofty palace for me so that I may mount up and be able to observe the god of Moses, even though I believe that Moses is a liar."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اسْتَكْبَرَ هُوَ وَ جُنُوْدُهٗ فِی الْاَرْضِ بِغَیْرِ الْحَقِّ وَ ظَنُّوْۤا اَنَّهُمْ اِلَیْنَا لَا یُرْجَعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And he and his hosts waxed arrogant in the land without any right, believing that they will never have to return to Us!

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَخَذْنٰهُ وَ جُنُوْدَهٗ فَنَبَذْنٰهُمْ فِی الْیَمِّ١ۚ فَانْظُرْ كَیْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الظّٰلِمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Eventually We seized him and his hosts and We flung them into the sea. So do see the end of the wrong-doers!

ayahs.arabicText: وَ جَعَلْنٰهُمْ اَئِمَّةً یَّدْعُوْنَ اِلَى النَّارِ١ۚ وَ یَوْمَ الْقِیٰمَةِ لَا یُنْصَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We made them leaders who invite people to the Fire. On the Day of Judgement they shall not find help from any quarter.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَتْبَعْنٰهُمْ فِیْ هٰذِهِ الدُّنْیَا لَعْنَةً١ۚ وَ یَوْمَ الْقِیٰمَةِ هُمْ مِّنَ الْمَقْبُوْحِیْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: We have made a curse to pursue them in this world, and on the Day of Judgement they shall be among the despised.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا مُوْسَى الْكِتٰبَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ مَاۤ اَهْلَكْنَا الْقُرُوْنَ الْاُوْلٰى بَصَآئِرَ لِلنَّاسِ وَ هُدًى وَّ رَحْمَةً لَّعَلَّهُمْ یَتَذَكَّرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: After We had destroyed the earlier generations We bestowed the Book on Moses - a source of enlightenment for people and a guidance and mercy -- that they may take heed.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا كُنْتَ بِجَانِبِ الْغَرْبِیِّ اِذْ قَضَیْنَاۤ اِلٰى مُوْسَى الْاَمْرَ وَ مَا كُنْتَ مِنَ الشّٰهِدِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: (O Muhammad), you were then not on the western side when We bestowed this commandment (of Law), and you were not among its witnesses.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لٰكِنَّاۤ اَنْشَاْنَا قُرُوْنًا فَتَطَاوَلَ عَلَیْهِمُ الْعُمُرُ١ۚ وَ مَا كُنْتَ ثَاوِیًا فِیْۤ اَهْلِ مَدْیَنَ تَتْلُوْا عَلَیْهِمْ اٰیٰتِنَا١ۙ وَ لٰكِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Thereafter We raised up many a generation and a long time passed. You were then not even present among the people of Midian to rehearse Our verses to them. But it is We Who are sending news about that.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا كُنْتَ بِجَانِبِ الطُّوْرِ اِذْ نَادَیْنَا وَ لٰكِنْ رَّحْمَةً مِّنْ رَّبِّكَ لِتُنْذِرَ قَوْمًا مَّاۤ اَتٰىهُمْ مِّنْ نَّذِیْرٍ مِّنْ قَبْلِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ یَتَذَكَّرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Nor were you on the side of the Mount (Sinai) when We called out to Moses (in the first instance). But it is out of Mercy from your Lord (that you are being informed of all this) so that you may warn a people to whom no warner came before you. Maybe they will take heed.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَوْ لَاۤ اَنْ تُصِیْبَهُمْ مُّصِیْبَةٌۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ اَیْدِیْهِمْ فَیَقُوْلُوْا رَبَّنَا لَوْ لَاۤ اَرْسَلْتَ اِلَیْنَا رَسُوْلًا فَنَتَّبِعَ اٰیٰتِكَ وَ نَكُوْنَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: (We did so) lest a calamity might seize them because of the misdeeds they committed whereafter they would say: "Our Lord, why did you not send a Messenger to us that we follow Your revelation and become among those who believe?"

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ الْحَقُّ مِنْ عِنْدِنَا قَالُوْا لَوْ لَاۤ اُوْتِیَ مِثْلَ مَاۤ اُوْتِیَ مُوْسٰى١ؕ اَوَ لَمْ یَكْفُرُوْا بِمَاۤ اُوْتِیَ مُوْسٰى مِنْ قَبْلُ١ۚ قَالُوْا سِحْرٰنِ تَظٰهَرَا١ٙ۫ وَ قَالُوْۤا اِنَّا بِكُلٍّ كٰفِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: But when the Truth reached them from Us, they said: "Why was he not given that which was given to Moses?" But did they not reject before what had been given to Moses? They said: "Both are magic, each supporting the other!" And they said: "We deny each of these."

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ فَاْتُوْا بِكِتٰبٍ مِّنْ عِنْدِ اللّٰهِ هُوَ اَهْدٰى مِنْهُمَاۤ اَتَّبِعْهُ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ صٰدِقِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Tell them, (O Prophet): "Then do bring a Book from Allah which is a better guide than either of them, and I will follow it! Do so if you are truthful!"

ayahs.arabicText: فَاِنْ لَّمْ یَسْتَجِیْبُوْا لَكَ فَاعْلَمْ اَنَّمَا یَتَّبِعُوْنَ اَهْوَآءَهُمْ١ؕ وَ مَنْ اَضَلُّ مِمَّنِ اتَّبَعَ هَوٰىهُ بِغَیْرِ هُدًى مِّنَ اللّٰهِ١ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا یَهْدِی الْقَوْمَ الظّٰلِمِیْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: But if they do not hearken to this, know well that they only follow their lusts and who is in greater error than he who follows his lusts without any guidance from Allah? Allah does not guide those given to wrong-doing.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ وَصَّلْنَا لَهُمُ الْقَوْلَ لَعَلَّهُمْ یَتَذَكَّرُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: We have constantly conveyed them the word (of admonition) that they may take heed.

ayahs.arabicText: اَلَّذِیْنَ اٰتَیْنٰهُمُ الْكِتٰبَ مِنْ قَبْلِهٖ هُمْ بِهٖ یُؤْمِنُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Those on whom We bestowed the Book before do believe in this (to wit, the Qur'an).

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِذَا یُتْلٰى عَلَیْهِمْ قَالُوْۤا اٰمَنَّا بِهٖۤ اِنَّهُ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَّبِّنَاۤ اِنَّا كُنَّا مِنْ قَبْلِهٖ مُسْلِمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: When it is recited to them they say: "We believe in it for it is the Truth from our Lord. Indeed we were already Muslims."

ayahs.arabicText: اُولٰٓئِكَ یُؤْتَوْنَ اَجْرَهُمْ مَّرَّتَیْنِ بِمَا صَبَرُوْا وَ یَدْرَءُوْنَ بِالْحَسَنَةِ السَّیِّئَةَ وَ مِمَّا رَزَقْنٰهُمْ یُنْفِقُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: These will be granted their reward twice over because they remained steadfast; they repel evil with good, and spend (in alms) out of the sustenance We provided them,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِذَا سَمِعُوا اللَّغْوَ اَعْرَضُوْا عَنْهُ وَ قَالُوْا لَنَاۤ اَعْمَالُنَا وَ لَكُمْ اَعْمَالُكُمْ١٘ سَلٰمٌ عَلَیْكُمْ١٘ لَا نَبْتَغِی الْجٰهِلِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: and when they hear any vain talk, they turn away from it, saying: "We have our deeds and you have your deeds. Peace be to you. We do not desire to act like the ignorant."

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّكَ لَا تَهْدِیْ مَنْ اَحْبَبْتَ وَ لٰكِنَّ اللّٰهَ یَهْدِیْ مَنْ یَّشَآءُ١ۚ وَ هُوَ اَعْلَمُ بِالْمُهْتَدِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet), you cannot grant guidance to whom you please. It is Allah Who guides those whom He will. He knows best who are amenable to guidance.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالُوْۤا اِنْ نَّتَّبِعِ الْهُدٰى مَعَكَ نُتَخَطَّفْ مِنْ اَرْضِنَا١ؕ اَوَ لَمْ نُمَكِّنْ لَّهُمْ حَرَمًا اٰمِنًا یُّجْبٰۤى اِلَیْهِ ثَمَرٰتُ كُلِّ شَیْءٍ رِّزْقًا مِّنْ لَّدُنَّا وَ لٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا یَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: They say: "If we were to follow this guidance with you, we should be snatched away from our land." Have We not established for them a secure sanctuary to which fruits of all kinds are brought as a provision from Us? But most of them do not know.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ كَمْ اَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ قَرْیَةٍۭ بَطِرَتْ مَعِیْشَتَهَا١ۚ فَتِلْكَ مَسٰكِنُهُمْ لَمْ تُسْكَنْ مِّنْۢ بَعْدِهِمْ اِلَّا قَلِیْلًا١ؕ وَ كُنَّا نَحْنُ الْوٰرِثِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: And how many a town did We destroy whose inhabitants exulted on account of their affluence. These are their dwellings in which very few dwelt after them. Eventually it is We Who inherited them.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ مُهْلِكَ الْقُرٰى حَتّٰى یَبْعَثَ فِیْۤ اُمِّهَا رَسُوْلًا یَّتْلُوْا عَلَیْهِمْ اٰیٰتِنَا١ۚ وَ مَا كُنَّا مُهْلِكِی الْقُرٰۤى اِلَّا وَ اَهْلُهَا ظٰلِمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Your Lord would not destroy a town until He had sent to its centre a Messenger who would recite to them Our verses. Nor would We destroy any town unless its inhabitants were iniquitous.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَاۤ اُوْتِیْتُمْ مِّنْ شَیْءٍ فَمَتَاعُ الْحَیٰوةِ الدُّنْیَا وَ زِیْنَتُهَا١ۚ وَ مَا عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ خَیْرٌ وَّ اَبْقٰى١ؕ اَفَلَا تَعْقِلُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Whatever you have been given is a provision for the life of this world and its glitter. But that which is with Allah is better and more enduring. Do you not use your intellect?

ayahs.arabicText: اَفَمَنْ وَّعَدْنٰهُ وَعْدًا حَسَنًا فَهُوَ لَاقِیْهِ كَمَنْ مَّتَّعْنٰهُ مَتَاعَ الْحَیٰوةِ الدُّنْیَا ثُمَّ هُوَ یَوْمَ الْقِیٰمَةِ مِنَ الْمُحْضَرِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Now, he to whom We have promised a good which he is going to obtain - can he be like him whom We have given the good things of this life, but who will be brought up for punishment on the Day of Judgement?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یَوْمَ یُنَادِیْهِمْ فَیَقُوْلُ اَیْنَ شُرَكَآءِیَ الَّذِیْنَ كُنْتُمْ تَزْعُمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: (Let them not forget) that the Day when Allah will call unto them, and say: "Where are those whom you imagined to be My associates?"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ الَّذِیْنَ حَقَّ عَلَیْهِمُ الْقَوْلُ رَبَّنَا هٰۤؤُلَآءِ الَّذِیْنَ اَغْوَیْنَا١ۚ اَغْوَیْنٰهُمْ كَمَا غَوَیْنَا١ۚ تَبَرَّاْنَاۤ اِلَیْكَ١٘ مَا كَانُوْۤا اِیَّانَا یَعْبُدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Those against whom the Word will be realised will say: "Our Lord, these are the ones whom we led astray just as we ourselves strayed. We absolve ourselves before You of all blame. It was not us that they worshipped."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قِیْلَ ادْعُوْا شُرَكَآءَكُمْ فَدَعَوْهُمْ فَلَمْ یَسْتَجِیْبُوْا لَهُمْ وَ رَاَوُا الْعَذَابَ١ۚ لَوْ اَنَّهُمْ كَانُوْا یَهْتَدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: They will then be told: "Call upon those for help whom you declared to be Our associates." They will then call upon them but they will not answer them. They will have observed the chastisement in front of them. Would that they were guided!

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یَوْمَ یُنَادِیْهِمْ فَیَقُوْلُ مَا ذَاۤ اَجَبْتُمُ الْمُرْسَلِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: (Let them not disregard) that the Day when Allah will call out to them saying: "What was the answer you gave to the Messengers?"

ayahs.arabicText: فَعَمِیَتْ عَلَیْهِمُ الْاَنْۢبَآءُ یَوْمَئِذٍ فَهُمْ لَا یَتَسَآءَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Then they will not be able to think of any reply, nor will they be able to ask one another.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَمَّا مَنْ تَابَ وَ اٰمَنَ وَ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَعَسٰۤى اَنْ یَّكُوْنَ مِنَ الْمُفْلِحِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: But those who repented and believed and acted righteously, they will perhaps be among those who will prosper there.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ رَبُّكَ یَخْلُقُ مَا یَشَآءُ وَ یَخْتَارُ١ؕ مَا كَانَ لَهُمُ الْخِیَرَةُ١ؕ سُبْحٰنَ اللّٰهِ وَ تَعٰلٰى عَمَّا یُشْرِكُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Your Lord creates what He will and chooses (for His tasks) whomsoever He will. It is not for them to make the choice. Glory be to Allah. He is exalted far above their associating others in His Divinity.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ رَبُّكَ یَعْلَمُ مَا تُكِنُّ صُدُوْرُهُمْ وَ مَا یُعْلِنُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Your Lord knows all that their hearts conceal and all that they reveal.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ هُوَ اللّٰهُ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ١ؕ لَهُ الْحَمْدُ فِی الْاُوْلٰى وَ الْاٰخِرَةِ١٘ وَ لَهُ الْحُكْمُ وَ اِلَیْهِ تُرْجَعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: He is Allah; there is no god but He. His is the praise in this world and in the Hereafter. His is the command and to Him will all of you be returned.

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ اَرَءَیْتُمْ اِنْ جَعَلَ اللّٰهُ عَلَیْكُمُ الَّیْلَ سَرْمَدًا اِلٰى یَوْمِ الْقِیٰمَةِ مَنْ اِلٰهٌ غَیْرُ اللّٰهِ یَاْتِیْكُمْ بِضِیَآءٍ١ؕ اَفَلَا تَسْمَعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet), tell them: "Did you consider: if Allah were to make the night perpetual over you till the Day of Judgement, is there a god other than Allah who can bring forth light for you? Do you not hear?"

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ اَرَءَیْتُمْ اِنْ جَعَلَ اللّٰهُ عَلَیْكُمُ النَّهَارَ سَرْمَدًا اِلٰى یَوْمِ الْقِیٰمَةِ مَنْ اِلٰهٌ غَیْرُ اللّٰهِ یَاْتِیْكُمْ بِلَیْلٍ تَسْكُنُوْنَ فِیْهِ١ؕ اَفَلَا تُبْصِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Say: "Did you consider: if Allah were to make the day become perpetual over you till the Day of Judgement, is there a god other than Allah who can bring in night for you that you may repose in it? Will you not see?"

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مِنْ رَّحْمَتِهٖ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الَّیْلَ وَ النَّهَارَ لِتَسْكُنُوْا فِیْهِ وَ لِتَبْتَغُوْا مِنْ فَضْلِهٖ وَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: It is out of His Mercy that He has made for you night and day that you may repose (during the night) and seek His Bounty (during the day) that you might be grateful.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یَوْمَ یُنَادِیْهِمْ فَیَقُوْلُ اَیْنَ شُرَكَآءِیَ الَّذِیْنَ كُنْتُمْ تَزْعُمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: (Let them bear in mind) that on that Day when He will call out to them saying: "Where are My associates, those whom you imagined to be so?"

ayahs.arabicText: وَ نَزَعْنَا مِنْ كُلِّ اُمَّةٍ شَهِیْدًا فَقُلْنَا هَاتُوْا بُرْهَانَكُمْ فَعَلِمُوْۤا اَنَّ الْحَقَّ لِلّٰهِ وَ ضَلَّ عَنْهُمْ مَّا كَانُوْا یَفْتَرُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: And from each people We shall draw a witness, and shall say to them: "Do produce your evidence now." Then they shall know that the Truth is with Allah alone, and the lies which they had invented will forsake them.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ قَارُوْنَ كَانَ مِنْ قَوْمِ مُوْسٰى فَبَغٰى عَلَیْهِمْ١۪ وَ اٰتَیْنٰهُ مِنَ الْكُنُوْزِ مَاۤ اِنَّ مَفَاتِحَهٗ لَتَنُوْٓاُ بِالْعُصْبَةِ اُولِی الْقُوَّةِ١ۗ اِذْ قَالَ لَهٗ قَوْمُهٗ لَا تَفْرَحْ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا یُحِبُّ الْفَرِحِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: To be sure, Qarun (Korah) was one of Moses' people; then he transgressed against them. We had bestowed on him such treasure that their very keys would have been raised with difficulty by a whole group of strong people. Once when his people said to him: "Do not exult, for Allah does not love those who exult (in their riches).

ayahs.arabicText: وَ ابْتَغِ فِیْمَاۤ اٰتٰىكَ اللّٰهُ الدَّارَ الْاٰخِرَةَ وَ لَا تَنْسَ نَصِیْبَكَ مِنَ الدُّنْیَا وَ اَحْسِنْ كَمَاۤ اَحْسَنَ اللّٰهُ اِلَیْكَ وَ لَا تَبْغِ الْفَسَادَ فِی الْاَرْضِ١ؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا یُحِبُّ الْمُفْسِدِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Seek by means of the wealth that Allah has granted you the Abode of the Hereafter, but forget not your share in this world and do good as Allah has been good to you and do not strive to create mischief in the land, for Allah loves not those who create mischief."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ اِنَّمَاۤ اُوْتِیْتُهٗ عَلٰى عِلْمٍ عِنْدِیْ١ؕ اَوَ لَمْ یَعْلَمْ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ قَدْ اَهْلَكَ مِنْ قَبْلِهٖ مِنَ الْقُرُوْنِ مَنْ هُوَ اَشَدُّ مِنْهُ قُوَّةً وَّ اَكْثَرُ جَمْعًا١ؕ وَ لَا یُسْئَلُ عَنْ ذُنُوْبِهِمُ الْمُجْرِمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: He replied: "All this has been given to me on account of a certain knowledge that I have." Did he not know that Allah had destroyed before him those who were stronger in might than he and were more numerous in multitude? The wicked are not asked about their acts of sin.

ayahs.arabicText: فَخَرَجَ عَلٰى قَوْمِهٖ فِیْ زِیْنَتِهٖ١ؕ قَالَ الَّذِیْنَ یُرِیْدُوْنَ الْحَیٰوةَ الدُّنْیَا یٰلَیْتَ لَنَا مِثْلَ مَاۤ اُوْتِیَ قَارُوْنُ١ۙ اِنَّهٗ لَذُوْ حَظٍّ عَظِیْمٍ
ayahs.translation: Once Korah went forth among his people in full glitter. Those seeking the life of this world said: "Would that we had the like of what Korah has! He truly has a great fortune."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالَ الَّذِیْنَ اُوْتُوا الْعِلْمَ وَیْلَكُمْ ثَوَابُ اللّٰهِ خَیْرٌ لِّمَنْ اٰمَنَ وَ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا١ۚ وَ لَا یُلَقّٰىهَاۤ اِلَّا الصّٰبِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: But those endowed with true knowledge said: "Woe to you. The reward of Allah is best for those who believe and act righteously. But none except those who are patient shall attain to this."

ayahs.arabicText: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهٖ وَ بِدَارِهِ الْاَرْضَ١۫ فَمَا كَانَ لَهٗ مِنْ فِئَةٍ یَّنْصُرُوْنَهٗ مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ١ۗ وَ مَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُنْتَصِرِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: At last We caused the earth to swallow him and his house. Thereafter there was no group of people that could come to his aid against Allah; nor was he able to come to his own aid.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَصْبَحَ الَّذِیْنَ تَمَنَّوْا مَكَانَهٗ بِالْاَمْسِ یَقُوْلُوْنَ وَیْكَاَنَّ اللّٰهَ یَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَنْ یَّشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهٖ وَ یَقْدِرُ١ۚ لَوْ لَاۤ اَنْ مَّنَّ اللّٰهُ عَلَیْنَا لَخَسَفَ بِنَا١ؕ وَیْكَاَنَّهٗ لَا یُفْلِحُ الْكٰفِرُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: And those who had envied his position the day before began to say on the morrow: "Alas, we had forgotten that it is Allah Who increases the provision of those of His servants whom He will and grants in sparing measure to those whom He will. But for Allah's favour upon us, He could have made us to be swallowed too. Alas, we had forgotten that the unbelievers do not prosper."

ayahs.arabicText: تِلْكَ الدَّارُ الْاٰخِرَةُ نَجْعَلُهَا لِلَّذِیْنَ لَا یُرِیْدُوْنَ عُلُوًّا فِی الْاَرْضِ وَ لَا فَسَادًا١ؕ وَ الْعَاقِبَةُ لِلْمُتَّقِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: As for the Abode of the Hereafter, We shall assign it exclusively for those who do not seek glory on earth nor want to cause mischief. The God-fearing shall have the best end.

ayahs.arabicText: مَنْ جَآءَ بِالْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهٗ خَیْرٌ مِّنْهَا١ۚ وَ مَنْ جَآءَ بِالسَّیِّئَةِ فَلَا یُجْزَى الَّذِیْنَ عَمِلُوا السَّیِّاٰتِ اِلَّا مَا كَانُوْا یَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: He who shall bring a good deed shall be rewarded with what is better. But those who bring evil deeds shall not be requited more than their deeds.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ الَّذِیْ فَرَضَ عَلَیْكَ الْقُرْاٰنَ لَرَآدُّكَ اِلٰى مَعَادٍ١ؕ قُلْ رَّبِّیْۤ اَعْلَمُ مَنْ جَآءَ بِالْهُدٰى وَ مَنْ هُوَ فِیْ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِیْنٍ
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet), surely He Who has ordained the Qur'an on you will bring you to the best end. Say to them: "My Lord knows best who has brought true guidance and who is in clear error."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا كُنْتَ تَرْجُوْۤا اَنْ یُّلْقٰۤى اِلَیْكَ الْكِتٰبُ اِلَّا رَحْمَةً مِّنْ رَّبِّكَ فَلَا تَكُوْنَنَّ ظَهِیْرًا لِّلْكٰفِرِیْنَ٘
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet), you never looked forward for the Book to be revealed to you. It is out of sheer Mercy of your Lord that it was (revealed to you). So do not lend any support to the unbelievers.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَا یَصُدُّنَّكَ عَنْ اٰیٰتِ اللّٰهِ بَعْدَ اِذْ اُنْزِلَتْ اِلَیْكَ وَ ادْعُ اِلٰى رَبِّكَ وَ لَا تَكُوْنَنَّ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِیْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: And let it never happen that the unbelievers might turn you away from the revelations of Allah after they have been revealed to you. Call people to your Lord and never become one of the unbelievers,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَا تَدْعُ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَ١ۘ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ١۫ كُلُّ شَیْءٍ هَالِكٌ اِلَّا وَجْهَهٗ١ؕ لَهُ الْحُكْمُ وَ اِلَیْهِ تُرْجَعُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: and do not invoke any god beside Allah. There is no god but He. All will perish but He. To Him belongs the command. And to Him shall all of you return.
